newsitem.title: GREECE: SOCCER-LOKO HAT-TRICK PUTS PSG INTO SEMIFINALS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LOKO HAT-TRICK PUTS PSG INTO SEMIFINALS.

text.p: A hat-trick from French international striker Patrice Loko guided holders Paris St Germain into the Cup Winners' Cup semifinals as they beat AEK Athens 3-0 on Thursday.
The teams had drawn the first leg 0-0 in Paris.
Loko fired home the first after 22 minutes and made it 2-0 two minutes before halftime when he latched on to Leonardo's pass.
Loko put the tie beyond doubt 10 minutes from the end of the game when he dribbled past one defender and coolly slotted past the Greek goalkeeper.
